name: Hazar Ergüçlü
bio:
Hazar Ergüçlü (born 1 January 1993) is a Turkish-Cypriot actress. She is best known for playing Zeynep in the series The Protector (2018–2020) and Eylül on the Turkish drama series Medcezir (2013–2015).

She has also starred in a number of films, including Gölgeler ve Suretler, Benim Dünyam, Kar, Gönül, and Ahlat Ağacı.
